proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ E _ _ M x
  constructor
  · intro hx f hf
    have hle : M.topologicalClosure ≤ LinearMap.ker (f : E →ₗ[𝕜] 𝕜) :=
      Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal M (fun m hm => hf m hm) (f.isClosed_ker)
    exact hle hx
  · intro h
    by_contra hn
    let N := M.topologicalClosure
    have hN : IsClosed (N : Set E) := M.isClosed_topologicalClosure
    have hq : ‖(Submodule.Quotient.mk x : E ⧸ N)‖ = Metric.infDist x (N : Set E) := QuotientAddGroup.norm_mk x
    have hd : ‖(Submodule.Quotient.mk x : E ⧸ N)‖ ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hq]
      exact fun h0 => hn ((hN.mem_iff_infDist_zero ⟨0, N.zero_mem⟩).mpr h0)
    obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := exists_dual_vector 𝕜 (Submodule.Quotient.mk x : E ⧸ N) hd
    let π : E →L[𝕜] (E ⧸ N) := N.mkQ.mkContinuous 1 (fun y => by
      simpa using Submodule.Quotient.norm_mk_le N y)
    have hπ : ∀ y, π y = Submodule.Quotient.mk y := fun y => rfl
    have h0 := h (g.comp π) (fun m hm => by
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hπ, (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero N).mpr (M.le_topologicalClosure hm), map_zero])
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hπ, hg] at h0
    exact hd (by exact_mod_cast h0)
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (E : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] (M : Submodule 𝕜 E) (x : E), x ∈ M.topologicalClosure ↔ ∀ f : StrongDual 𝕜 E, (∀ m ∈ M, f m = 0) → f x = 0
